bio: I'm a certified software engineer who builds websites, mobile apps and AI-driven solutions that solve real-world problems. I mix creativity, software development and artificial intelligence to turn ideas into real opportunities.

process.title: Discover
process.text: You tell me what you need and who it's for.

process.title: Plan

faq.q: What can you build for me?
faq.a: Business websites, e-commerce stores, platforms, mobile apps, AI features and automations.

faq.q: How long does a project take?
faq.a: It depends on the size. I'll give you a clear timeline once I know the scope.

faq.q: Can you add AI to my existing website?
faq.a: Yes. I can add AI chat, smart search or automated workflows to a site you already have.

faq.q: Do you work with clients outside Nigeria?
faq.a: Yes. I work with clients anywhere, fully remote.
